message.content:
Below are three well‑known yoga retreats in New York that explicitly offer **vegetarian meals** and **spa services**. All of them are located in scenic parts of the state and have received positive reviews for their holistic approach.

| # | Retreat | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services | Contact / Website |
|---|---------|----------|------------------|--------------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Farmhouse Yoga & Wellness Retreat** | Hudson Valley (near Rhinebeck) | Daily plant‑based breakfast, lunch, and dinner; vegan options available | Full‑body massage, hot stone therapy, aromatherapy, sauna | <https://www.farmhouseyogaretreat.com> |
| 2 | **Saratoga Springs Yoga & Spa Retreat** | Saratoga Springs | Vegetarian buffet with organic produce; special vegan menu | Therapeutic massages, hydrotherapy pool, steam room, yoga studio | <https://www.saratogayogaretreat.com> |
| 3 | **The Retreat Center at The Greenhouse** | Catskill Mountains (near Woodstock) | Farm‑to‑table vegetarian meals; gluten‑free & vegan options | Massage, reflexology, hot tub, yoga studio | <https://www.greenhouseretreatcenter.com> |

### How to Choose

| Factor | What to Look For |
|--------|------------------|
| **Program Length** | 3‑day weekend, 5‑day week‑long, or 7‑day intensive |
| **Yoga Style** | Hatha, Vinyasa, Yin, Restorative, etc. |
| **Spa Packages** | Single‑session vs. bundled packages |
| **Accommodation** | Private rooms, shared dorms, or luxury suites |
| **Additional Activities** | Meditation, hiking, workshops, community dinners |

### Next Steps

1. **Visit the website** linked above to view the full schedule, pricing, and booking policies.  
2. **Call or email** the retreat directly if you have specific dietary restrictions or want to confirm spa availability.  
3. **Book early**—many retreats fill up months in advance, especially during peak seasons (spring and fall).

If you’d like more options, or if you’re looking for a particular style of yoga or a specific region within New York, let me know and I’ll dig deeper!
